Frontend half of the IDUNA_PRO Skills-categorization change (Apple #18891): Category dropdown per skill row, grouped-by-category screen preview (groupSkillsByCategory, a direct JS port of the Go grouping logic, kept in lockstep across all three templates), and a new Auto-organize with AI button wired to the real Vertex AI endpoint. node --check clean.
